Fall Yoga Retreat: A Refuge for Your Heart

October 16-18, 2026

with Chaya Spencer at Lifebridge Sanctuary, Rosendale, NY

A true refuge is more than a place. It is a space where the mind grows quiet, the body softens, and the heart feels safe. It is where we can set down the weight of daily responsibilities, reconnect with what matters most, and remember the steady center that lives within us. In times of challenge, refuge restores us. In times of ease, it deepens our connection to ourselves and to one another.

Join us for a nourishing weekend retreat at Lifebridge Sanctuary, nestled in the beauty of the Catskills. Through yoga, meditation, time in nature, wholesome meals, meaningful conversation, and spacious periods of rest and reflection, you’ll be invited to slow down and settle into a deeper sense of presence and belonging.

In the yogic tradition, there is a beautiful Sanskrit phrase: hridaya vishranti—reposing in the heart. Here, “heart” does not refer to the physical organ or even the emotional heart, but to our essential nature, the innermost core of who we are. Vishranti means rest, repose, or deep relaxation. Together, these words point to the experience of resting in our own being, returning home to ourselves.

This retreat offers a supportive cocoon for renewal and self-discovery. Come away for a weekend of rest, connection, and renewal. Return home grounded, refreshed, and reconnected to the essence of who you are.

Our retreat center, Lifebridge Sanctuary, offers us a space of peace, nature and quiet to introspect, practice yoga, eat well and rest in beauty inside and out. The Sanctuary is a 12,000 square foot hand crafted, green facility on 95 acres of forest and spectacular open space on the Northern crest of the Shawangunk Ridge, less than 90 minutes from Shree.
